public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer link to product, resources, academy, blog, company, and legal content, but do not provide a public product documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent funding round I could verify was announced in June 2023, outside the 18-month period before 2026-11-09.

founded_year.notes: The LinkedIn company profile lists 2022 as the founding year.

last_funding.notes: Typeface announced a $100 million Series B round in June 2023.

launched_6mo.notes: Typeface announced the next generation of its Orchestration Engine on September 22, 2026, within the six months before 2026-11-09.

pricing_page.notes: The site navigation and footer provide product, demo/contact-sales, resources, and company links, but no pricing link; no public pricing page was found.

employee_band.notes: Trueup reports an estimate of about 150 people, which maps to 101-200. LinkedIn's broader company-size range is 51-200, so the narrower band relies on the 150-person estimate.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current Greenhouse board lists Enterprise Account Executive roles for the East and West regions.

model_provider.notes: I checked the product/security material, privacy notice, trust-portal references, and relevant blog material. They discuss enterprise models, cloud infrastructure, and AI capabilities but do not publicly identify a specific AI model or model provider.

named_customers.notes: The cited post names these brands and describes them as partnering with Typeface. The customer-stories index also exists, though its case-study titles anonymize the companies.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Greenhouse board lists a Senior ML Engineer opening.

compliance_certs.notes: These certifications are explicitly named on Typeface's security and governance page.

crm_stack_signal.notes: All listed systems appear in Typeface's Connector Library as CRM, marketing automation, customer-data, or campaign platforms.

product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes an enterprise marketing platform for orchestrating AI agents, brand intelligence, and workflows to create personalized, on-brand campaigns.
product_one_liner.value: Typeface provides an enterprise marketing AI platform that uses brand intelligence, AI agents, and connected workflows to help marketing teams create and orchestrate personalized, on-brand campaigns.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company page identifies the founder/CEO but does not provide a complete, dated leadership roster; I found no verifiable C-level or VP joining or departure announcement in the period. The evidence is insufficient to assert either a positive or negative answer.
